name: PTR Job Status State
description: Last observed status and active tracking flag for one Press record.

fields.label: State Key
fields.description: SHA-256 of the record type and record name.

fields.label: Record Name
fields.description: Name of the Press record to reconcile.

fields.label: Observed Status
fields.description: Status represented by the latest durable outbox event.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Whether the next existing Press trigger must inspect this record.
